profile.headline: LMTS - R&D - Software Engineer at Salesforce
profile.summary:
Wow, the below summary is so very old and yet still true at a high level.  I won't put much time into trying to update my "about blurb" atm [Oct 22, 2024].  Suffice it to day, instead of "small scale" web applications ... Since early 2008, I have been working on the largest scale SAAS and PAAS technologies at Salesforce with a focus on testing and quality.

Here is what I had to say just prior to joining Salesforce, I think? ...

Web Application Developer designing, building, testing, and maintaining all aspects of small scale web applications.  Particularly interested in programming techniques including Ajax, web accessibility, and w3c standards which optimize the web app user experience bringing it in line with that of a desktop application and without the associated overhead.  Interested in collaborating on larger scale projects such as enterprise systems.

Specialties: Java, JavaScript, CSS, XHTML, SQL, MySQL, accessibility, usability, w3c web standards

positions.title: Web Application Engineer
positions.description:
Web application development utilizing web standards methodology.  Technologies: Java (jsp, servlets, JSTL), JavaScript, AJAX, XHTML, CSS, SQL, MySQL

- All aspects of design, implementation, test, deployment, and maintenance of a web application from which customers can query inventory data as well as input and view shipment orders.
  - architecture: Model View Controller(MVC)
  - user interface(View): XHTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX techniques, W3C web standards
  - data processing(Controller, Model): Java, JSTL
  - data persistence/management(Model): MySQL RDBMS, SQL
- Install/configure/maintain development and production environments.
  - Development environment: Mac OS X(Unix - Darwin), Apache Tomcat, MySQL, Eclipse, jEdit, Ant, Log4j, Subversion
  - Production environment: Linux FC, Apache Tomcat, MySQL
- System is relatively platform independent - functionally tested on Mac OS X and WinXP: Mozilla(Firefox 1+), IE6+, Opera 8+.

positions.title: Technical Support Administrator
positions.description:
- Manage technical support issues for Mills College faculty and staff.
- Design/implement an online training services program including website and seminar design.
- Design/implement web page documentation including user options - HTML or interactive video (Flash) tutorial - for Mills College web mail and for adjusting TCP/IP settings to use DHCP for wireless access to the Mills College network.

positions.title: Off Shore Supervisor
positions.description:
- Supervise, hire, schedule and evaluate staff performance; oversee daily office operations.
- Develop and maintain relationships with international agents and shipping partners.
- Create customer and agent guidelines for pricing strategies, operations policies, and procedures.
- Establish and maintain ISO standards for the Department.

positions.title: Off Shore Tracking Coordinator
positions.description:
- Establish and implement procedures for overseeing the new Off Shore Department, Air Freight, including operations, freight tracking, and customer billing.
- Automate rating and costing process by building MS Excel programs. Significant improvements in productivity included reduced error margins and streamlined operations.  Specifically, our department handled a 300 percent increase in shipment quantity with a staff increase of only 25 percent.

patents.title: Service Cloud Console
patents.description: Various embodiments described or referenced herein are directed to different devices, methods, systems, and computer program products for providing contextual information via a user interface provided in a web browser. The user interface may display a plurality of components including a first component displaying object record information associated with an object record stored in a database and a second component displaying contextual information related to the stored object record information. Edited object record information may be received at the client machine. An indication of the edited object record information may be provided to the second user interface component of the user interface in the web browser. A request for updated contextual information related to the edited object record information may be transmitted from the client machine to the server. The updated contextual information may be displayed in the second user interface component of the user interface.
